title: Operation: Defeat the Four Spirits
text: “I see. So, has the king—who was under house arrest—been evacuated yet?”
“Yes. We’re escorting him out.”

That was quick. Wouldn’t it have been better to evacuate the castle along with him? By now, Melromarc Castle and the town below it have been completely obliterated by the strong acid rain rained down by the Dragon King.
“Anyway, we need to devise a strategy now. We’ll also have to head toward Faubrey to defeat the Qilin.”
My father declares this with great vigor. That’s right. There’s still hope.
“So? What about the information and locations of the Spirit Tortoise, the Phoenix, the Qilin, and the Dragon King?”
“Here.”

The Queen unfolds a world map and begins marking the extent of the damage. The Phoenix, whose seal was broken first, is moving the fastest. It’s running rampant, mainly in the regions west of Melromarc.

Reports say the damage is escalating as it roams day and night, relentlessly hunting down lives. Its familiars are also very active. Based on the latest information I’ve confirmed, after the Qilin’s seal was broken, it apparently began to be shrouded in lightning.

Next is the Spirit Tortoise. It seems to be operating primarily in the regions east of Melromarc. In the first world, it came toward Melromarc, but I’ve heard it has now changed direction. Although its movements are slow, many of the Spirit Tortoise’s familiars are fast, so the damage is steadily increasing.

Furthermore, as soon as the Dragon King’s seal was broken, water reportedly began overflowing from the mountain range on its back. It’s said a lake is forming right around the Spirit Tortoise. If you get too close, you’ll be submerged and drown.
And then there’s the Dragon King… It’s said to be drifting all over Melromarc, causing rain of strong acid to fall. On top of that, its familiars have appeared and seem to be running amok.

Finally, there’s the Qilin. We didn’t fight it in the original world, but in the game, it was a boss that mastered the power of wind. Its elemental attributes are similar to the Spirit Tortoise’s special attack, but I recall it also wielded lightning.
Word has it that this one is heading toward nearby Faubrey and running amok there. Since Faubrey has advanced firearms, perhaps the remnants of Takt could handle it? Let’s go ask them.
“Shouldn’t we send them on a suicide mission without telling the remnants of Takt?”
I don’t think they’re all top-tier fighters.
“Yes. It seems the Faubrey army, led by former members of Takt’s group, challenged them to battle, but the results weren’t very promising.”
That’s strange. Could they really be such a tough opponent just because Takt isn’t there? In the first world, they were supposed to be mere minions that Takt and his group could defeat. …
“Father. Come to think of it, I feel like the Dragon King put up a bit of a fight.”
“The incredibly strong Motoyasu-kun finding an enemy a challenge? Well, given those subjugation conditions, isn’t that a bit tough?”
“No, that’s not it. I get the feeling he’s fundamentally become stronger.”

“…Come to think of it, the other Four Spirits also showed changes at the same time the other Four Spirits were revived… Could it be that, like weapon enhancements, their effects stack on top of each other…?”
Father’s face is turning pale. So are everyone else at the strategy meeting.
“We might be better off focusing our attention on protecting ourselves.”
“I-I know, but shouldn’t we fight to overcome this disaster, even if just a little?”
“Since they’re not delivering the finishing blow to the Four Holy Ones, the Seven Stars might be okay too.”
“It’d be a disaster if the rest of our comrades got killed! Or are you saying we should take them on all by ourselves?”
“That’s not my intention. But… are you telling us to just stand by and watch the world get torn to shreds?”
My father is arguing with the panda Beastman.
“I understand exactly how you feel, Lars-chan. But… I refuse to let this injustice go unchallenged.”
“Sigh… I get it. I’m a mercenary too. I know there are situations that can’t be resolved with money alone. I was in the wrong, too.”
Huh? The argument settled down pretty quickly.
“With so many newly chosen Seven Stars around, we’ve got no choice but to do this, right? For someone like me who gets paid to fight, this is a tremendous honor.”
“Lars-chan.”
“But since I’ve been chosen as a Hero, I’m going to be expensive—so brace yourself.”
“U-un!”
It looks like my Father and the panda Beastman have become quite close. My fiancée is staring at them as if she wants to say something. But without saying a word, she moved closer to Sakura-chan.
“I’ll do my best, too.”
“Gaelion will do her best, too! I want to defeat the Dragon King and claim all the Dragon Emperor’s Shards!”
“I think I’ll be asking Wyndia-chan and the others to take on some dangerous battles as well. I hope they’ll do their best.”
“Yeah.”
“What about Sakura?”
“Sakura-chan too. As for Melty-chan…”
“I’ll fight for the world, too!”

Before my Father could finish his sentence, my Finacée cut him off and declared this. I sensed a very strong resolve in her. That’s right! I can’t let myself be outdone either. For the sake of true peace, as Filo-tan told me, I’ll keep fighting.
“Lord Motoyasu, no matter what happens, Yuki will carry out your orders.”
“Don’t push yourself too hard.”
“I understand. It is only by fulfilling orders without overreaching that one becomes a truly strong warrior.”
Yuki-chan is such a hard worker—I can’t let her push herself too far. But in a situation that’s too much for me to handle alone, I have no choice but to step up.
“I’ll do my best too, big bro!”
“Keel-kun. Don’t push yourself too hard. Luna will make up for it!”
“Luna-chan”
“So… Keel-kun. Once this battle is over, Keel-kun will be Luna’s…”
“Big bro! I’ll do my best too!”
Huh? Keel seems to be telling my Father that he wants to stay away from Luna-chan.
“Kou’s going to fight alongside everyone, too!”
“That’s right. Yuki-chan. Since Kou, Sakura-chan, and Luna-chan are among the earliest Filolial-samas, they must properly guide the Filolial-samas who were raised later.”
“Yeah! I’ll do my best alongside Yuki!”
Having heard everyone’s resolve, my Father gave a slight nod before replying.
“We’ve settled on our resolve. Next, let’s settle things with the remaining Seven Star Warriors before we take on the battle. After all, we have to defeat the Four Spirits all at once.”

And so, a meticulous strategy for defeating the Four Spirits was devised. However, as luck would have it, the staff dwelling within Trash didn’t respond to my father or my words. The gauntlets are in the Land of the Phoenix, and apparently, the remaining weapons were taken by the chosen Seven Star Warriors, who fled somewhere. What a hassle.

Now, first up is the last of the Four Spirits: the Dragon King. I’ll be the one to take it on. My allies will be the Filolial-samas—excluding Yuki-chan and her group—and Yuki-chan and my Father handled the specific assignments. Apparently, the Melromarc Army will also be assisting us as backup. The Queen is here as well.

The plan is to use the Filolial-sama’s mobility to lure the fragments of the Dragon King to a single location, and then, at the designated time, I’ll finish it off with my ultimate skill and Magic. It’s a strategy that turns the Four Spirits’ instinct to target life against them, using 100 Filolial-sama and the Melromarc Army to lure them in.

I voiced my concern that the Filolial-sama’s safety might be at risk, but they themselves responded with a strong determination to cooperate, so I nodded in agreement. Oh well, I’ll just have to do my best.

Next is the Qilin, whose seal was broken in Faubrey. Apparently, my Father will lead the expedition, accompanied by his Finacée, Sakura-chan, and Lazy Pig. Since these are the Four Spirits we’ve never fought even in the future, we’ll need to be flexible in our approach—plus, there’s a request from Faubrey to summon the Four Holy Heroes.

Also, it seems the Faubrey Army will be cooperating. I’m a little uneasy about that. The plan is to take down a pair of Qilins at once. The plan is for my Father to hold them off while Sakura-chan, with her high firepower, finishes them off.

As for the Phoenix, which has caused the most damage, the task falls to my Assistant, my Rival, Yuki-chan, and Keel. Since the Phoenixes stand out too much when acting separately, the plan is to defeat one of them first to trigger an explosion. My Rival and Yuki-chan were selected because they have the mobility needed to either escape or catch up afterward.
They’re gathering a coalition force to ensure we never lack rear support. The strategy is the same as my Father’s. We’ll take them down exactly as planned.

And finally, there’s the Spirit Tortoise. We’ll be counting on the Panda Beastman, Kou, and Luna-chan to handle this one. The method for defeating it is foolproof—apparently, the Panda Beastman is tasked with destroying its head. With Kou and Luna-chan there, I’m sure we’ll manage to take care of the heart. The allied forces will provide cover for the Panda Beastman.

However, coordinating the date and time for the operation proved difficult. Traveling by airship was slower than expected due to atmospheric fluctuations, and since the Four Spirits were on the move, it took time to reach our destination. Well, only my Father headed to Faubrey.

In the meantime, we were guiding people to safety in areas likely to be affected by the Four Spirits. But the number of victims just keeps rising. We heard that the blue sand in the hourglass located in the Phoenix Lands—which have been reduced to a scorched wasteland—is steadily… increasing.

In any case, it took nearly a week from the time the airship carrying my Father arrived in Faubrey until the schedule for subduing the Four Spirits was set—and that was after we’d already taken down Takt. At this point, there are actually fewer regions in the world that haven’t suffered damage than those that have.
